newsitem.title: CHINA: China firecracker factory blast kills 14.
newsitem.headline: China firecracker factory blast kills 14.

text.p: An explosion at a firecracker factory in southern China killed 14 people and injured 29, officials said on Monday.
The November 27 accident in Shimen county in Hunan province prompted a crackdown on similar factories in the area, a county government official said by telephone.
The official attributed the explosion to "operational carelessness" by an 18-year-old technical adviser who died in the blast. Official media gave no reason for the delay in reporting the accident.
"There was nothing left. It was levelled to the ground," the official said of the two-storey building housing the firecracker factory.
Most of the victims were villagers helping out at the factory, the official said. He declined to give further details.
